hypothesis: V22 pairwise ranking was the only recent TCN objective with positive continuous net, but its fixed 0.3 policy gate admitted poorly calibrated score buckets and DD exceeded 35% at1x. Keep the causal TCN and pairwise utility ranking; add a fixed margin loss that separates realized net >=0.3% candidates from the synthetic WAIT boundary, using only each past fold's labels.
selection: Fixed8 epochs, all3 seeds x11 contiguous folds, no winner-seed or fold selection and no threshold/portfolio tuning. Gate threshold, temperature and loss weights are versioned here before training. All dates are opened development, not an independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; report gross, fees, funding, coverage and fills. No live approval.
compute: Private free Kaggle T4x2 only for heavy training; local GTX1650 inference/replay/backtests. Do not mutate v19/v21/v22/v23 exports.
